title: Sunlight certificate-transparency deduplication cache collision
summary: A 128-bit deduplication-cache collision could yield an SCT for a certificate omitted from the log, with approximately 2^64 work according to the maintainer. In WebPKI the described route also requires a colluding, compromised or otherwise vulnerable CA because certificate serial entropy constrains offline collision preparation.
ai_role: The Sunlight release says these vulnerabilities were discovered by Claude and triaged by Anthropic’s security team in collaboration with Anthropic Research.
classification_note: The cited source documents public disclosure; it does not establish whether the issue was previously known to defenders or exploited before disclosure.
remediation_note: Sunlight v0.8.1 changes new cache keys to 256 bits. The release also retains legacy-key queries and describes optional cache recomputation; upgrading alone does not eliminate every legacy-key consideration.

impacts.conditions: The maintainer describes a theoretical route to an SCT for a certificate omitted from the log; approximately 2^64 work and the stated WebPKI CA prerequisite apply.
impacts.exploitation: The cited primary source does not report observed exploitation.
